assets.what: Host portrait: Pon, tanuki stand-up comedian, MC of Oogiri Night

Wears a small coral-orange bow tie and holds a vintage silver stage microphone, mid-joke, eyes twinkling, a big warm good-natured laugh-ready smile, one paw open towards the audience. assets.what: Optional stage backdrop: dark haunted late-night TV studio, low contrast for readable text
assets.prompt: Wide establishing shot of an empty late-night TV variety show studio after midnight, haunted but cosy and inviting, inspired by Japanese tsukumogami folklore. A small stage with heavy velvet curtains, an old wooden host desk at one side, a stack of old CRT television monitors glowing faintly, unlit studio spotlights on a rig overhead, a few paper lanterns giving soft warm glows, faint wisps of ghostly mist drifting across the floor, a few loose blank dictionary pages floating gently in the air.
